text_block_list.text:
The year-end, and also Tokai Teio's 
biggest showdown: the day of the Arima 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The time has finally come, Trainer. My 
race against the President."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even now, the President is who I admire 
most of all, and that won't change even 
after the race is over.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If anything's going to change, I think 
it'll be how the fans view me."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"The most amazing Umamusume is Tokai 
Teio!" ...Right!
choice_data_list: Go out there and bring home the win!
Make sure you win out there!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Umu, leave it to me! Everyone's cheers 
belong solely to WAGAHAI-samaaa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I'm off, Trainer. Keep your eyes 
glued on me!
